title: Ripple Basin
description: If you did not play any Attacks during your turn, gain 4 Block.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: At the start of each turn, Ripple Basin becomes Active. If no Attack cards are played during your turn, it grants 4 Block at the end of the turn. Playing any Attack card removes the effect for that turn.
